name: apply-migration-destructive-supabase-server
description: Destructive apply_migration through a Supabase MCP server added under the key "supabase". Must BLOCK (exit 2).
provenance: Tool name as Claude Code reports it for this Supabase MCP install path (hooks reference: MCP tools are mcp__<server>__<tool>; plugin-bundled servers are mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>__<tool>). Matcher ^mcp__.+__apply_migration$ must fire; expectation identical to apply-migration-destructive.
